blurb: Guests can rent pontoon boats with professional navigation orientation to explore Hilton Head waterways including Broad Creek, May River, and Cooper River. Private tubing trips are available for groups up to 12 passengers. The Golden Hour Sunset Sail offers a 2-hour catamaran cruise with complimentary drinks and coastal bites. The Daufuskie Island Day Trip includes ferry, golf cart rental, and meal vouchers.

quotes.author: Brandi N.
quotes.text: Our family had a great experience with Island Head Watersports! My daughters loved the adventure. The Captain, Taylor, was very friendly, knowledgeable and informative about the process, boat, and HHI! The staff was very responsive while scheduling as well.

quotes.author: Bill C.
quotes.text: Outstanding parasail this morning for myself and two kids. Perfect balance of fun and safety. We never felt like just another customer and I know that must not be easy when you're doing this day in and day out. Highly recommend this outfit to anyone.

quotes.author: Ming Y.
quotes.text: Lovely boat ride with little to no turbulence. Staff clearly knew what they were doing. The parasailing experience is phenomenal-- it's an exhilarating ride with great views! I have a mild fear of water but even I felt safe 100% of the time.

quotes.author: Denise K.
quotes.text: Felt safe and enjoyed the whole experience. Great crew to work with. They explained the process taking off and landing and assured our safety. Knowledgeable crew of HHI. Beautiful sights on boat and in air.

quotes.author: Melissa R.
quotes.text: Hibachi Cruise is so much fun! Boat captain is great. We saw so many dolphins! Cruised past spanish wells, wexford & sea pines. Fun lively chefs and bartender… a good time was had by all!

quotes.author: Gregory M.
quotes.text: Steve and Nate were terrific!!! What a day! What an experience!! I would absolutely recommend to anyone wanting a great time on the Island to use Island Head!!!

quotes.author: Dee H.
quotes.text: Great ferry ride to Dafuskie Island! Captain shared info about the area and was super friendly to chat with! Would definitely use this company again!
